svg.text: Lane V, part 1 — the transport-blind foundation and the radio interface
Task groups 1.2 and 1.3, inside V2X_ECU/. Left column = no predecessor at all.
the stand-in modem cannot acknowledge calls
the interface has not declared, and faults cannot
be injected into a state machine that does not
exist yet — so the chain admits no shortcut.
closed — verified by a green CI lane
